ground_truth.description: The diff threads the concrete 'Use project_root="..."' directive into assemble_payload and _format_assembled_payload, but _assemble_remediation_payload was not updated and still ends with only the project_id guideline. Because all three payloads share the same STAGE1_SYSTEM_PROMPT (which now instructs the agent to call mcp__fused-memory__get_task with project_root=<project_root>), a Stage 1 agent running a remediation pass is told to perform the terminal-state pre-check but never receives the concrete project_root value in its payload — inconsistent with the diff's stated goal of threading project_root.

The new instruction directs the agent, on any get_task error envelope, to 'skip the terminal-state write without flagging'. Since a get_task error can be transient/inconclusive, this path can silently drop a genuine terminal-state contradiction (no temporal_fact written and no Stage 2 flag), producing a false negative in terminal-state reconciliation — matching the 'review passed but escalation_created' symptom noted for this task.

task.title: Stage 1 Terminal-State Pre-Check: use FQN tool names, thread project_root, handle get_task error envelope, pin concrete flag_type
task.description: The Terminal-State Pre-Check Discipline and UUID Resolution Discipline sections added in stage1.py:32-34, 65-78, and 80-95 (task 1144) are inert or misleading as written due to four gaps: bare tool names undermine call-signature precision in the new sections, the agent has no project_root in context, there is no instruction for the get_task error envelope case, and there is no concrete flag_type for dedup. Four coordinated fixes are required to make the new sections operational and internally consistent.
task.details:
FILES_TO_MODIFY:
  - fused-memory/src/fused_memory/reconciliation/prompts/stage1.py
  - fused-memory/src/fused_memory/reconciliation/stages/memory_consolidator.py
  - fused-memory/src/fused_memory/reconciliation/flag_dedup.py
  - fused-memory/tests/reconciliation/test_stage1.py

DETAILS:
**1. FQN tool names in UUID Resolution Discipline and Terminal-State Pre-Check Discipline (stage1.py lines 32-34, 65-78, 80-95):**
The helper note at lines 32-34, UUID Resolution Discipline at lines 65-78, and Terminal-State Pre-Check Discipline at lines 80-95 refer to tools as bare names (`get_task`, `search()`, `delete_memory`) while the rest of stage1.py uses fully-qualified MCP form (`mcp__fused-memory__get_task`, etc., e.g. lines 21-30, 53-54, 98). Replace all bare names with `mcp__fused-memory__get_task`, `mcp__fused-memory__search`, and `mcp__fused-memory__delete_memory` to match the existing file convention. Pure prompt-text change; no behavioral change. Verify with existing prompt snapshot tests in fused-memory/tests/reconciliation/.

**2. Thread project_root through MemoryConsolidator.assemble_payload** (stage1.py:84-85 + memory_consolidator.py:171-198 / 237-261). The new prompt instructs `mcp__fused-memory__get_task(id=<task_id>, project_root=<project_root>)`, but the payload assembler never exposes `self.project_root` to the agent. The MCP `get_task` tool requires `project_root: str` (server/tools.py:1539-1543). Without injecting the value, the agent will skip verification or hallucinate a path, defeating the discipline. Stage 2 already solves this in task_knowledge_sync.py:767/907 by emitting `Use project_root="{self.project_root}" for tasks scoped to this project.` Mirror that pattern in both branches of MemoryConsolidator.assemble_payload (and `_format_assembled_payload`). Guard for empty `self.project_root` so the line is omitted when the harness has not registered a root.

**3. Handle get_task error envelope** (stage1.py:87-89). The current discipline only addresses agreement vs disagreement between live status and the claimed terminal state. It does not address the third case: `mcp__fused-memory__get_task` returning an error envelope (`{'error': ..., 'error_type': ...}` per server/tools.py:1561-1563). Without instruction, the agent will likely treat the error envelope as either disagreement (spurious flags) or agreement (writes anyway). Add a sentence to the prompt: "If `mcp__fused-memory__get_task` returns an `error` field, treat verification as inconclusive — skip the terminal-state write without flagging."

**4. Pin concrete flag_type** (stage1.py + flag_dedup.py): The terminal-state pre-check section instructs Stage 1 to write a dedup flag but does not specify a concrete `flag_type` value. Without a pinned value, Stage 1 invents one each run and flag_dedup's dedup key `(task_id, flag_type)` never matches across cycles. Pin a concrete literal (e.g. `"terminal_state_pre_check"`) in the prompt text and add a corresponding constant in flag_dedup.py so both the prompt and the dedup logic reference the same string.

All four fixes must be verified with tests in fused-memory/tests/reconciliation/test_stage1.py (prompt snapshot tests for item 1, unit tests for items 2-4).
